name: T-90M Proryv
armament: 12.7 mm Kord on remote commander's mount
protection: Welded turret with Relikt ERA, slat cage on the turret bustle, Shtora (A) or none (M). Game: hull and turret immune to all small-calibre and to 7.62x54R/12.7/14.5 mm (those only break optics, searchlights, external MGs and track pins). Kills need launchers: Javelin/NLAW top-attack, AT4/MAAWS/SMAW or RPG-7 PG-7V to side, rear or roof; frontal ERA defeats single-charge PG-7V.
visual_notes: Angular welded turret (T-90A/M) with wedge-shaped Relikt ERA panels on the front and side 'wings'; T-90S (AZE) has the older cast turret with Shtora IR dazzler 'eyes' either side of the gun
Large bustle stowage box with slat armour around the turret rear (T-90M)
6 road wheels per side, side skirts with ERA blocks on the front third
Kalina FCS: commander's panoramic sight on the roof, gunner's sight box
2026 Russian vehicles: welded roof anti-drone cage or tall mesh shelter, anti-drone netting, EW jammer antennas, mine-roller (KMT) on some

colour_schemes.name: Russian protective green with white Z/V/triangle ID marks
